en: Dependent on a wholesome state appertaining to training (*sekha*), a state that is neither wholesome nor appertaining to training arises by way of root condition. (Two roots. Under root condition there are six; under predominance condition there are six ... pe ... under resultant condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on an indeterminate state appertaining to one beyond training (*asekha*), a state that is neither wholesome nor appertaining to training arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on an indeterminate state appertaining neither to training nor to one beyond training, a state that is not indeterminate and appertaining neither to training nor to one beyond training [arises]...

It arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are five; ... [and so on] ... under the repetition condition there are three; ... [and so on] ... under the result condition there are three; ... [and so on] ... under the non-disappearance condition there are five.
